name: Philip IV of Macedon
contribution: Briefly king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedonia in 297 BC.

checks.lead: Philip IV (Ancient Greek: Φίλιππος, romanized: Phílippos) was briefly king of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedonia in 297 BC. He belonged to the Antipatrid dynasty and was the son of Thessalonike, daughter of Philip II, and Cassander, king of Macedonia.
